cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.

mechanism: A approves the rules and judging of a dinner competition so every practical difference becomes a contest A expects to win.
confusable: Competitive rule changing alone is the Drive; the Stance must make B alternatives subject to A authorization as contestant and self-appointed official.
comparison: Dinner choices move from cost to favored judging; the tea alternative moves from strength to speed and then endurance.
seedUse: Use D19-a cost tie and favored potatoes; S01 must govern which proposed competition is admitted.
